title: The Animal That Lives Without a Head
hook: A cockroach can survive for weeks without its head.
script: A cockroach can survive for weeks without its head. It breathes through tiny holes along its body, not through a mouth. Its nerves are spread out, so a headless body can still stand and react. So what finally kills it? Thirst. With no mouth, it cannot drink, and slowly dries out. Being cold-blooded, it burns so little energy that going without food is no rush. Why would evolution build an animal that hard to kill? It has outlived the dinosaurs, and barely changed in three hundred million years.
